verdict.rationale: SavvyCal's developer docs say users can connect Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, VS Code, or another MCP client to check their calendar, find open times, book meetings, and manage links from a chat. That is first-party support for natural-language operation, but it depends on a third-party AI client and rests on a single brief mention. missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language interface, detailed MCP server docs (tool list, setup, scope of supported actions), and independent or hands-on corroboration that chat-driven operation works.
